units.source_text: 今天他懒得去见葵姬，先赴二条院，再出门看贺茂祭。

en.t: Today he felt too disinclined to go and see Lady Aoi, so he first went to the Nijo residence, and then went out to watch the Kamo Festival.

units.source_text: 他到了紫姬所居的西殿里，便命惟光准备车辆。

en.t: When he arrived at the western wing where Lady Murasaki lived, he ordered Koremitsu to prepare the carriage.

units.source_text: 对那些年幼的侍女们说：“你们也去看，好不好？”

en.t: He said to the young maidservants, "Would you like to go and see it too?"

units.source_text: 这一天紫姬打扮得非常美丽，源氏公子满面笑容地对她看。

en.t: That day Lady Murasaki was dressed very beautifully, and Prince Genji looked at her with a smile all over his face.
I will go and watch it together with you."

units.source_text: 紫姬的头发今天梳得特别光洁，源氏公子用手摸摸，对她说：“你的头发长久不剪了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's hair had been combed especially smooth and glossy that day, and Prince Genji touched it with his hand and said to her, "It has been a long time since your hair was cut.
I suppose today must be an auspicious day?"

units.source_text: 便召唤占卜时日吉凶的博士，教他卜定一个吉时。

en.t: He then summoned a diviner who judged the fortune of dates and times, and had him determine an auspicious hour.

units.source_text: 又对小侍女们说：“你们先去吧。”

en.t: He also said to the little maidservants, "You go on ahead."

units.source_text: 他看看这些女童的美丽的衣饰，但见每人的头发都很可爱，梳得很整齐，浓重地挂在浮纹的罗裙上，有娇小玲珑之感。

en.t: He looked over the girls' beautiful clothing and saw that each one's hair was charming, neatly combed, and hung thickly over her figured gauze skirt, giving an impression of delicate, tiny grace.
